notes: All 12 views inspected. Three-masted galleon with a planked hull, wales, gunports with red lids, a raised sterncastle with glazed lantern windows, a beakhead bow, three masts with yards and furled-and-set square sails, a bowsprit with jib, standing rigging and shrouds, a rudder and a painted waterline. The bottom view shows a complete hull with keel rather than an open shell, and the stern decoration is present and symmetrical. Sails are modelled as curved surfaces with visible seams.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
Sails and rigging are static geometry; they will not billow or sway without a rig or cloth simulation.
No crew, cargo or armament is included.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
